title: Crumbling Crypt Entrance
description: A yawning doorway sinks into the hillside, its stone lintel carved with faded runes that still pulse faintly against the dark. Cold air seeps from within, carrying the mineral tang of old earth and something sweeter — embalming oils, perhaps. Iron fittings on the door frame have turned green with age but remain stubbornly intact.

choices.label: Explore the crypt
choices.description: The dead sometimes leave their wealth behind.

outcomes.text: You duck through the low archway and find a ransacked burial chamber — but the looters missed a coin pouch wedged beneath a collapsed shelf.
The crypt opens into a surprisingly intact vault. Gold and grave dust coat every surface — a rich haul.
Something stirs in the darkness as you enter. Cold hands claw at your arms before you stumble back into the light, bleeding and shaken.

choices.label: Collect the grave dust
choices.description: Fine grey dust coats every surface — alchemists pay well for it.

outcomes.text: You scrape the grey powder into pouches. It smells of old death and copper — exactly what the alchemists want.
Beneath the dust you find a layer of crystallized bone marrow. A lucky bonus.
The dust clouds your vision and burns your lungs. You cough and wheeze, managing only a meager handful.

choices.label: Leave it alone
choices.description: Some crypts are best left undisturbed.

outcomes.text: You give the crypt a wide berth. The runes pulse once more as you pass, then dim to nothing.
